purpose: Focused protected-mode Ghidra closure for the camera/map refresh boundary called by 01F7:321F.

source.independent_projects: project-a and project-b decompilation/listing outputs matched

contracts.name: reset_stream_and_event_banks_17AE
contracts.calling_convention: far; no explicit arguments; RETF; no caller-consumed flags
contracts.inputs_outputs: Writes byte values 0..0x7f to DS:8960, clears DS:895E, then clears the first word of each 0x80 eight-byte record at DS:6586 with an eight-byte stride.
contracts.scheduler_position: Camera/map rebuild reset boundary; clears event ownership before later declaration/event publication.
contracts.object_effects: Resets the dedicated event/stream bookkeeping; does not clear pooled object callbacks directly.
contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes indirectly through event/stream ownership and later ARE publication

contracts.name: update_camera_scroll_1ED7
contracts.calling_convention: far; no explicit arguments; eight-byte BP frame; RETF; no caller-consumed flags
contracts.inputs_outputs: Copies DS:81AA/81A6 to DS:81B2/81AE, forms local target positions from DS:60DC/60E0 plus DS:81A6/81AA, integrates DS:60DC/60E0 into DS:81BE/81C2, clamps against DS:36FC..3700 and DS:36FE..3702, refreshes crossed map strips/pages, derives DS:81CE/81D0, and commits DS:81A6/81AA.
probe_coordinates: Y boundary refresh uses DS:81AC and DS:370E
X boundary refresh uses DS:81A8 and DS:370C
map tile/image coordinates are passed to 20C8 or 2CB2
contracts.scheduler_position: Called by 01F7:321F during reload/camera rebuild before the next object scheduler pass.
contracts.object_effects: Invokes map-strip/column preparation and page-copy helpers; the 1CDA call in the enclosing 321F path can instantiate streamed ARE objects.
contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes; camera/stream globals and ARE declaration timing can change later gameplay state

callees.name: normalize_camera_y_in_1ED7_frame_2064
callees.flags: caller-local helper; updates DS:8176/DS:370A and BP-local target

contracts.name: copy_prepared_vga_map_3062
contracts.calling_convention: far; inherited register/page-list arguments; returns a register value not consumed by 321F; no gameplay flags
contracts.inputs_outputs: Saves/restores graphics-controller state, copies prepared rows from page-list records rooted at DS:3718 through DS:817A/DS:817C, processes pending prepared entries rooted at DS:3778, and restores VGA state.
contracts.scheduler_position: Presentation tail of the 321F refresh loop.
contracts.object_effects: Copies already-prepared map/page data; does not allocate objects or rewrite MAP/descriptor words.
contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: no direct player, MAP, descriptor, scheduler, or callback-global simulation feedback
